newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tianjin Industrial seen seeking HK listing in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Tianjin Industrial seen seeking HK listing in Q2.

text.p: China-backed Tianjin Industrial Holdings Ltd is expected to raise about HK$1 billion a listing on the Hong Kong stock exchange in the second quarter of 1997, market sources said on Tuesday.

Market sources said Tianjin Industrial, which is backed up by Tianjin municipal government, is expected to come onto the market as a red-chip with a diversified business including retail and industrial investment.
Sources said the sponsor of the issue had yet to be decided and no other listing details were available to the market.
Expectation of possible future assets injection is likely to raise the attractiveness of the issue, they said.
